issues.title: Header and cell alignment mismatch
issues.description: The Length column header alignment does not match its cell data alignment.
issues.evidence: The 'Length' header is aligned left while the duration values below are aligned right.
issues.suggestion: Align the header text to the right to match the cell content.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: TableHead base class used physical text-left, so in RTL headers hug the left while cells align to start (right). Fixed with logical text-start (plus pr-0→pe-0 sweep and demo text-right→text-end).
